caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a fabric item shaped like a rounded trapezoid with a flat top edge and gently curved sides that taper outward before rounding at the bottom corners and connecting at the base. The item features vertical blue and white stripes running its full length. There is a blue border outlining the entire shape, including the top, sides, and bottom edges. A central vertical slit extends downward from the top edge, also bordered with blue fabric. Near the top right of the item, there are small embroidered letters in a tan color. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the striped pattern of the fabric.
title: Shaker Woman's Money Bag
